privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: The short version: this app doesn't track you, and without an account nothing leaves your device.

local.title: What's stored on your device
items: Your settings: theme, accent, language, formats and tool preferences.
Your favourites and the order of the tools.
Whatever you create in each tool — tasks, notes, lists, history.
All of it in the browser's local storage, under the “amano:” prefix.

none.title: What doesn't happen
items: No analytics, no tracking cookies, no ads.
None of your content is sent to a server.
No permission is requested unless you turn that feature on first.

account.title: If you sign in (optional)
items: Data only reaches a server if you create an account — your own Supabase project.
What syncs: settings, favourites, tasks, shopping list, notes, time zones, spinner options, colours, team names and currency preferences.
Each row carries your user id, and the database's security policies stop anyone else reading or writing your rows.
Passwords and sessions are handled by the Supabase library itself: this app never stores passwords or tokens on its own.
You can delete your cloud data at any time from Settings → Account.

network.title: When the internet is used
items: The first time you open the app, to download it and store it for offline use.
To check for updates to the app itself.
The currency converter will fetch public exchange rates once it's available.
If you're signed in, to sync your data with your Supabase project.

control.title: What you control
items: Export a copy of your data at any time from Settings → Data.
Delete everything stored on this device with one button — there's no undo.

privacy.contact: This app is published as a static website, so whoever hosts it only sees ordinary web requests.

error.raizNegativa: A negative number has no real square root

paso.lineal.infinitas: Both sides are identical: any value of x works.
paso.lineal.ninguna: We're left with a false statement: there's no solution.
paso.cuadratica.doble: Δ = 0, so there's a single repeated solution: x = {x}.
paso.cuadratica.negativo: Δ = {d} is negative: there are no real solutions.
paso.sistema.infinitas: Both equations are the same line: infinitely many solutions.
paso.sistema.ninguna: The two lines are parallel: no solution.
paso.sistema.despejaX: Solve the first for x: x = ({c1} + {b1}y) ÷ {a1}.
paso.sistema.sustituye: Substitute that x into the second equation.
paso.sistema.multiplica: Multiply the first by {m1} and the second by {m2} to match the x coefficients.
paso.sistema.resta: Subtract the two equations so x cancels out.
paso.fracciones.comun: Common denominator: the LCM of the two is {m}.
paso.fracciones.multiplica: Multiply top by top and bottom by bottom: ({n}) / ({d}).
paso.fracciones.invierte: Dividing by {b} is the same as multiplying by {inv}.
paso.fracciones.divideAmbos: Divide top and bottom by their GCD, which is {g}.
paso.mcd.inicio: We look for the GCD of {a} and {b} using Euclid's algorithm.
paso.mcd.resultado: The last non-zero remainder gives GCD = {g}.
paso.mcd.mcm: And the LCM comes from LCM = ({a} × {b}) ÷ GCD = {m}.
paso.factor.inicio: We break {n} down by dividing by primes.
paso.factor.esPrimo: {n} divides only by 1 and itself: it's prime.
paso.regla.inicioDirecta: Direct proportion: if {a} matches {b}, what matches {c}?
paso.regla.inicioInversa: Inverse proportion: if {a} matches {b}, what matches {c}?
paso.pct.queInicio: We want to know what percentage {a} is of {b}.
paso.pot.inicio: We work out {b} to the power of {e}.
paso.pot.negativo: A negative exponent flips the base: 1 ÷ ({b} to the power of {e}).
paso.pot.decimal: Non-integer exponent: worked out as a decimal, {r}.
paso.pot.raizInicio: We work out the square root of {n}.
paso.est.mediana: The median, the middle value, is {mediana}.
